acceptanceCriteria: refresh refuses a log with a malformed line, a truncated final event, or a started package with no terminal outcome, with a test for each.
The existing refresh of real `go test -json` shard logs still succeeds and produces the same table bytes.
body: tools/ci-shard-costs/main.go: the advisory `check --advisory` path (report, line ~375) reads each log through observeStream, i.e. scan(..., strict=true), which refuses non-JSON lines, damaged events and packages that start without a terminal outcome. The table-writing refresh and plain check path (line ~96) reads through observe, i.e. scan(..., strict=false), so a truncated or damaged shard log can still feed the committed cost table (AFP-V0-040 lane, PR #730 merged). Expected: any input that updates .github/cishards costs is held to at least the advisory report's standard. Suspected defect from review; no corrupted table has been observed.
